5543.title: [Skia] Sync m150 region and texture fixes
5543.body:
[Skia] Sync m150 region and texture fixes (#5543)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/417
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5546
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4605

Update release/4.150.x to native merge
95bed8d58d692e6268f05682f0a4926f41aaf5fb, incorporating chrome/m150 through
f05f0f5f8f3a2cbbcc3f48d887695398bf2584cf. Keep release-line versions and
managed API declarations unchanged.

~~ Prevent conic-region buffer underallocation ~~

Bring in the upstream correction for SkRegion::setPath allocating too few
scanline transitions for subdivided conics. Budget edges using the shared
conic subdivision limit and reject accumulation overflow before building
the region, preventing a heap out-of-bounds write.

~~ Correct BGRA-as-RGBx upload capabilities ~~

Disable the RGBA upload format for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx,
matching the existing BGRA-as-RGBA restriction. The old capability was
permitted by desktop GL but unsupported by GLES.

~~ Preserve texture subset boundaries under nearest filtering ~~

Retain shader clamps when magnification or fractional mappings can round
sample coordinates into neighboring texels. Keep the touching-edge fast
path for one-to-one integer-relative mappings, including rotations and
flips, and account for sampling precision at approximate-proxy boundaries.

~~ Make Linux GL validation execute reliably ~~

Backport the Linux test-harness subset of #4605 rather than skipping
Ganesh GL on the validation host. Load versioned X11/GL libraries,
initialize Xlib threading, share the process GLX display and place the
affected GPU test classes in a nonparallel collection.

Resolve assembled-interface symbols from libGL.so.1 rather than relying
on glXGetProcAddress: GLVND can return non-null dispatch stubs for names
that are not real functions. Serialization is a separate context-lifetime
precaution, not the correction for that symbol-resolution failure.

The workflow reports that Ganesh GL executed with Mesa softpipe during
the unfiltered release-branch console solution run.

~~ Accept installed Linux emoji fallback families ~~

Allow Symbola, Noto Emoji and Noto Color Emoji on glibc Linux hosts, and
Noto Color Emoji on non-glibc hosts, instead of requiring Symbola for
every Linux environment. This changes test expectations, not product font
selection.

~~ Record the completed native merge consistently ~~

Update both externals/skia and the mono/skia Component Governance hash to
the actual native merge, and record the incorporated upstream commit.
Verify the two-parent merge directly contains reviewed head
49a7ef98174b2aa4d98de24e17d04d6b3018e9a9 and has the identical source tree.

The sync workflow reports a passing Linux x64 source build, unchanged
generated declarations, managed build and unfiltered console solution:
5,748 core tests, one singleton test, two Vulkan-host tests and two
Direct3D-host tests passed. Platform-policy skips remain; Linux execution
does not establish Windows Vulkan, Direct3D or Metal runtime coverage.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
